name: Walker Dennis

intro.text: The cliff path goes all round the north coast. Best views in the Channel, and the worst bit is the stairs. A great many of them, and my knees have counted.

win: Aye, you've beaten the cliffs and me. I'll sit down.
after: Keep to the path after dark. There's a story about a black dog on this stretch. I don't believe it. I've just never been out here at night to check.
